amendment_reason: The T1.26 primary rule keyed the H1 decision on W2 direction alone and yielded outcome=overlap_dependent. RA review found this contradicted by the mandatory landscape-L2 complement (H1 landscape L2 still rejects on the remainder, p=0.000999, same as full BHPS) and confounded by the n=3,202 / 100% landmark-fraction reduction (full BHPS ran L=5000 on n=8,509, ~59% fraction), where H1 is known landmark-sensitive (T1.2). This amendment adds a dual-metric rule and a two-arm test to separate a genuine overlap effect from a sample-size/landmark-fraction artefact before locking P01-A section 6.2.

entries.name: BHPS non-overlap re-analysis (overlap vs size/landmark artefact)
entries.depends_on: results/panel_methodology/bhps_nonoverlap/bhps_only_gmm_ph_2026-06-09.json (T1.26; H0 cleanly preserved on both metrics; H1 W2 flip = the object of this re-analysis)
entries.objective: Determine whether the T1.26 H1 W2 reversal on the non-overlap BHPS remainder reflects genuine dependence on the spanning/overlap individuals, or a sample-size / landmark-fraction artefact, using a dual-metric (W2 + landscape L2) decision rule.

arm_a_matched_fraction.description: Re-run the non-overlap remainder (n=3,202) at a landmark count matching the full-BHPS landmark fraction (~0.588), i.e. L ~= round(0.588 * 3202) ~= 1882, instead of the 100% fraction used in T1.26.

arm_b_size_control.description: Draw K=20 seeded random subsamples of the FULL BHPS (n=8,509, INCLUDING spanning individuals) at n=3,202 each; run the H1 W2 + landscape headline on each at the same landmark setting as the non-overlap remainder. Build the same-size null band for the H1 W2 d_perm (and p).
reports: null_band over d_perm (mean, sd, q025, q975)

decision_rule.size_or_fraction_artefact: If Arm A H1 W2 rejects at the matched fraction OR the T1.26 remainder H1 W2 d_perm lies WITHIN the Arm B same-size null band (inside [q025, q975]), the W2 flip is attributable to sample size / landmark fraction, NOT to the overlap individuals -> P01-A section 6.2 non-overlap / replication reframing is SUPPORTED (with disclosure of the small-n sensitivity).
decision_rule.overlap_dependent: If Arm A H1 W2 does NOT reject at the matched fraction AND the T1.26 remainder is an OUTLIER versus the Arm B null band (outside [q025, q975] on the suppression side), the H1 asymmetry is genuinely overlap-dependent -> section 6.2 discloses overlap-dependence, reframing NOT licensed.
decision_rule.dual_metric_note: The landscape-L2 complement is reported throughout. A W2 'artefact' conclusion is corroborated by landscape L2 continuing to reject (signal present); a W2 'overlap_dependent' conclusion must note whether landscape L2 also weakens. Per CONVENTIONS, no H1 conclusion rests on W2 alone.
